name: Rotate PDF
desc: Rotate all or selected PDF pages and save
seoTitle: Rotate PDF Pages Online: Free and Private
seoDescription: Rotate PDF pages online for free. Turn all pages or only selected ones by 90, 180 or 270 degrees and download the fixed file. No upload.
intro: Fix a sideways scan or an upside-down page. Rotate every page, or just the ones you choose, and download a corrected PDF.
steps: Drop a PDF into the box.
Choose the rotation and whether it applies to all pages or selected ones.
Click Rotate and download the new PDF.

faq.q: Can I rotate only some pages?
faq.a: Yes. Choose 'Selected pages' and enter numbers like 1, 3-5.
No. The change is made in your browser.
